rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_pop_dopa_hdc(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) NOT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) NOT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	target int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result5 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_pop_dopa_hdc WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_pop_dopa_hdc
(
SELECT
	 @id,vh.hospcode,vh.villcode,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com
	,@b_year+543 as b_year,p.total,e.result1,e.result2,e.result3,e.result4,e.result5
FROM
 cvillage_hosp vh
LEFT JOIN (
			SELECT hospcode,areacode,total FROM s_midyearpopmoph WHERE b_year=(@b_year+543)
) as p  ON  vh.villcode=p.areacode

LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT pe.check_hosp HOSPCODE,pe.check_vhid areacode 
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(pe.check_typearea in(1),pe.cid,null)) result1
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(pe.check_typearea in(2),pe.cid,null)) result2
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(pe.check_typearea in(3),pe.cid,null)) result3
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(pe.check_typearea in(1,3),pe.cid,null)) result4
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(pe.check_typearea in(1,2),pe.cid,null)) result5
		FROM  t_person_cid pe 
		WHERE pe.DISCHARGE in(9) AND pe.NATION IN(99)
		GROUP BY pe.check_vhid
) e ON  vh.villcode=e.areacode
WHERE SUBSTR(vh.villcode,1,2) in(@prov_c)
GROUP BY vh.villcode
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_pop_dopa_hdc_hosp(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) NOT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) NOT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	target int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result5 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_pop_dopa_hdc_hosp
(SELECT * FROM s_pop_dopa_hdc WHERE hospcode <> '00000');

DELETE FROM s_pop_dopa_hdc_hosp WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_pop_dopa_hdc_hosp
(
SELECT
	 @id,vh.hospcode,vh.villcode,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com
	,@b_year+543 as b_year,p.total,e.result1,e.result2,e.result3,e.result4,e.result5
FROM
 cvillage_hosp vh
LEFT JOIN (
			SELECT hospcode,areacode,total FROM s_midyearpopmoph WHERE b_year=(@b_year+543)
) as p  ON  vh.villcode=p.areacode

LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT pe.check_hosp HOSPCODE,pe.check_vhid areacode 
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(pe.check_typearea in(1),pe.cid,null)) result1
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(pe.check_typearea in(2),pe.cid,null)) result2
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(pe.check_typearea in(3),pe.cid,null)) result3
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(pe.check_typearea in(1,3),pe.cid,null)) result4
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(pe.check_typearea in(1,2),pe.cid,null)) result5
		FROM  t_person_cid pe 
		WHERE pe.DISCHARGE in(9) AND pe.NATION IN(99)
		GROUP BY pe.check_vhid
) e ON vh.villcode=e.areacode
WHERE SUBSTR(vh.villcode,1,2) in(@prov_c)
GROUP BY vh.villcode
);

UPDATE s_pop_dopa_hdc SET hospcode='00000' WHERE b_year IN(@b_year+543);

province.label: จังหวัด
province.query: SELECT h.chw_code as a_code,h.changwatname as a_name , SUM(target) as target1 ,SUM(result1) as result1 ,SUM(result2) as result2 ,SUM(result3) as result3 ,SUM(result4) as result4 ,SUM(result5) as result5  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT chw_code,changwatname,zone_code,zone_name FROM ccaatt ) as h    LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s  ON h.chw_code=left(s.areacode,2) AND s.b_year={{YEAR}}  WHERE 1=1 AND (h.zone_code={{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{ZONE_CODE}})     AND (h.chw_code={{PROVINCE_CODE}} or {{PROVINCE_CODE}}='ALL')  GROUP BY h.chw_code,h.changwatname  ORDER BY h.chw_code

ampur.label: อำเภอ
ampur.query: SELECT h.amp_code as a_code,h.ampurname as a_name , SUM(target) as target1 ,SUM(result1) as result1 ,SUM(result2) as result2 ,SUM(result3) as result3 ,SUM(result4) as result4 ,SUM(result5) as result5  FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT amp_code,ampurname,chw_code,changwatname,zone_code,zone_name FROM ccaatt) as h  LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s  ON h.amp_code=left(s.areacode,4) AND s.b_year={{YEAR}}  WHERE 1=1 AND (h.chw_code={{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{PROVINCE_CODE}})    AND (h.amp_code={{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}='ALL')    GROUP BY h.amp_code,h.ampurname  ORDER BY h.amp_code

tambon.label: ตำบล
tambon.query: SELECT h.tmb_code as a_code,h.tambonname as a_name , SUM(target) as target1 ,SUM(result1) as result1 ,SUM(result2) as result2 ,SUM(result3) as result3 ,SUM(result4) as result4 ,SUM(result5) as result5  FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT tmb_code,tambonname,amp_code,ampurname,chw_code,changwatname,zone_code,zone_name FROM ccaatt) as h  LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s  ON h.tmb_code=left(s.areacode,6) AND s.b_year={{YEAR}}  WHERE 1=1 AND (h.chw_code={{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code={{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}})   GROUP BY h.tmb_code,h.tambonname  ORDER BY h.tmb_code

moo.label: หมู่บ้าน
moo.query: SELECT s.areacode as a_code ,CONCAT('หมู่ที่ ',SUBSTR(s.areacode,7,2)) as a_name, SUM(target) as target1 ,SUM(result1) as result1 ,SUM(result2) as result2 ,SUM(result3) as result3 ,SUM(result4) as result4 ,SUM(result5) as result5 FROM ccaatt as h INNER JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.tmb_code=left(s.areacode,6) AND (h.tmb_code={{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} WHERE 1=1 AND (h.chw_code={{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code={{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) GROUP BY s.areacode ORDER BY s.areacode
